cohort: Individuals born in Sweden between 1973 and 2014 with information on both biological parents (n = 4,242,122), including 1804 subjects with NF1 and 450 with tuberous sclerosis
finding: Children with NF1 and tuberous sclerosis were more likely to be born preterm and via cesarean delivery, with the strongest associations observed for high birth weight and large for gestational age in individuals with NF1.
mod_finding: Children with neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1) and tuberous sclerosis were significantly more likely to be born preterm and via cesarean delivery.
